outcome: self-reported symptom distress (Breathe and Cough items)
cohort: Adult English- and Spanish-speaking women scheduled for an elective cesarean birth participated in the study.
finding: Women using an abdominal binder after cesarean birth reported a decrease in pain after ambulation and less distress on specific symptom items, although they used more ibuprofen and acetaminophen.
mod_finding: The use of an abdominal binder after cesarean birth was found to decrease pain and symptom distress, potentially enhancing postoperative recovery.
